tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground of every screen. Never pure white; never OLED black.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Content surfaces: lists, tables, forms, paper preview, opaque fallback for glass.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Raised panels, drawers, popovers, hovered rows.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inset wells: table headers, input backgrounds inside glass, code/formula blocks, skeleton base.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and sections.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input outlines, table frames, chip borders — 3:1 against surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and glass.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Labels, supporting copy, DCI lines, tab labels — on bg, surface, surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, timestamps, placeholders only — on bg, surface, surface-raised (4.5:1 kept).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Deep medical blue. Primary buttons, links, selected navigation, search caret, first chart series. Never a card fill.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/active of brand fills and links.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-soft (selected rows, active pills).

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: The only brand tint allowed as a fill: selected row, active quick action, current tab pill, sequential-scale start.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand and brand-hover fills.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Clinical teal, reserved for two meanings: computed results (result block, compute button) and trust (verified marks, completed steps). Second chart series. Never a module colour, never evidence strength.

tokens.name: teal-strong
tokens.usage: Text on teal-soft.

tokens.name: teal-soft
tokens.usage: Teal tint for result blocks and verified badges.

tokens.name: on-teal
tokens.usage: Text on teal fills.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Admin console bar only. In dark it is lifted above `bg` (never equal to it) and always carries a 1px `border` bottom edge. Never body text on light.

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Text and icons on navy, and on the toast.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text/icon on success-soft or surface; always with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success tint: verified state fills, saved confirmations.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text/icon (near max dose, expiring verification or subscription, cached pack older than 30 days) on warning-soft or surface. Always with icon + word.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning tint: grace-period banner, precaution rows, near-max-dose guard, outdated-pack banner.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Critical text/icon (contraindication, max dose exceeded, rejected) on critical-soft or surface.

tokens.name: critical-soft
tokens.usage: Critical tint: capped-dose guard, contraindicated interaction rows, expired banner.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational text/icon on info-soft or surface; data-version and update notices.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Info tint: update-available chip, content-under-review banner, data-freshness chips.

tokens.name: sponsored
tokens.usage: Text of the SponsoredLabel on sponsored-soft; used nowhere else so sponsorship is unmistakable.

tokens.name: sponsored-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the SponsoredLabel and the sponsored block in search results.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring, 2px offset, on every interactive element; ≥3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Clinical Glass fill with blur-glass; fallback to surface. Search, top bar, bottom nav, quick actions, floating controls, sheets.

tokens.name: glass-border
tokens.usage: 1px border of every glass surface.

tokens.name: hero-start
tokens.usage: Top of the hero gradient (Home, Welcome, profile headers): the brand, deepest shade.

tokens.name: hero-mid
tokens.usage: Middle stop of the hero gradient: the brand, lightened.

tokens.name: hero-end
tokens.usage: Bottom of the hero gradient, fading into the page ground.

tokens.name: on-hero
tokens.usage: Text and icons on the deep part of the hero gradient.

tokens.name: on-hero-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on the hero (greeting line, metadata).

tokens.name: glass-on-hero
tokens.usage: Frosted controls on the hero: icon buttons, quick actions, avatar ring. Always with blur-glass.

tokens.name: glass-on-hero-border
tokens.usage: Hairline edge of glass-on-hero surfaces: the light catching the glass.

tokens.name: glass-tint
tokens.usage: Brand-tinted frosted panels: segmented tracks, summary panels, the floating bar.

tokens.name: glass-highlight
tokens.usage: Inner top edge of floating glass (bottom bar, hero cards).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind modals, sheets and the command palette.

tokens.name: skeleton
tokens.usage: Skeleton blocks. Static fill; no shimmer (motion rule L9).

tokens.name: viz-3
tokens.usage: Third chart series (sponsored revenue). Series order: brand, teal, viz-3, viz-4, viz-5.

tokens.name: viz-4
tokens.usage: Fourth chart series (other revenue) and comparison/previous-period lines.

tokens.name: viz-5
tokens.usage: Fifth chart series. Never used for status meaning.

tokens.name: trace
tokens.usage: The ECG trace (section marker, page loader) — always the brand ink, via mask so it follows the theme.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines and axis baseline.

tokens.name: chart-axis
tokens.usage: Chart axis labels and tick text.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Selected text background and keyboard-selected rows in lists and tables.

tokens.name: on-navy-subtle
tokens.usage: Wells and chips inside the navy console bar (search well, environment tag).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Document paper (prescriptions, certificates, previews). Identical in both themes: paper is always white.

tokens.name: paper-ink
tokens.usage: Text on paper in both themes.

tokens.name: paper-rule
tokens.usage: Rules, header divider and watermark text on paper, both themes.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Welcome, pricing, admin overview header only. Never inside a clinical workflow.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page titles, drug name in the header, sheet titles.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section and tab headings, dialog titles, table group headers.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Adapter la posologie à la clairance de la créatinine.
styles.usage: Reading text, clinical prose, form values.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Medication names in rows and search results, list row primaries.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, badges, chips, tab labels, table headers, DCI lines.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata, timestamps, evidence footers, helper text.

styles.name: numeric
styles.usage: Any column of numbers: tables, doses, amounts. Set font-feature-settings "tnum".

styles.name: result
styles.usage: The single calculator or dose result. One per screen. Tabular figures.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Transaction IDs, versions, formulas, references codes.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside chips, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between inline controls, chip gaps, row internal vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input horizontal padding, list row padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter, section padding, card/panel padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Glass panel padding, sheet content padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections, desktop page gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between major blocks (summary → sections), dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Top of a page below the top bar on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state vertical padding, welcome spacing.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Marketing/landing rhythm and sidebar collapsed width.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, inline inputs in rows, table cells editing.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, list rows, selection cards, result blocks.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Glass panels, drawers, popovers, command palette.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Bottom-sheet top corners, mobile search overlay.

tokens.name: radius-xxl
tokens.usage: Hero cards, the content sheet over the hero, the floating bottom bar.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, avatars, segmented controls, the raised search tab.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: popovers, hovered selection cards.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Overlays only: dialogs, drawers, sheets.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Every Clinical Glass surface. Very soft; no glow.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating glass only: the bottom bar and cards lifted over the hero. Brand-tinted, never a glow.

blur.note: Backdrop blur for Clinical Glass. Always paired with the glass fill and glass-border, with a surface fallback.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: Top bar, bottom nav, search field, quick actions, floating controls.

tokens.name: blur-strong
tokens.usage: Command palette, bottom sheets and overlays over busy content.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls; pointer-events none.

tokens.name: opacity-scrim-strong
tokens.usage: Only for the restricted-document viewer backdrop; everything else uses the scrim color token.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: All dividers and glass borders.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Inputs and chips (border-strong); 2px on error/success states.

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring width, 2px offset.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, toggles, result fade-in.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Tabs, sheets, search expansion, drawers on mobile.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Desktop drawers and page-level panes. Nothing slower exists.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Entrances: sheets, palette, toasts.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Movement: tab indicator, sidebar collapse.

tokens.name: bp-mobile
tokens.usage: < 640: bottom nav, sheets, single column.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: 640–1023: collapsed icon sidebar, single or two columns.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: Sidebar 240, split panes, keyboard shortcuts, admin minimum.

tokens.name: bp-wide
tokens.usage: Admin tables full width; clinical content stays 1120 centered.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky headers, section nav, result bar.

tokens.name: z-bar
tokens.usage: Top bar, bottom nav, floating glass controls.

tokens.name: z-drawer
tokens.usage: Drawers and bottom sheets.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Command palette, dialogs, scrim.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts above everything.

size.note: Fixed dimensions used by layout and controls. Heights are minimums; touch variants apply below bp-tablet.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, dense table actions, admin filters.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Default desktop buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: size-control-lg
tokens.usage: Mobile inputs and primary buttons, search field.

tokens.name: size-touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target on any pointer:coarse device.

tokens.name: size-row-dense
tokens.usage: Admin and desktop table rows.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: List rows (search results, recents, settings).

tokens.name: size-topbar
tokens.usage: Web top bar and admin console bar (48px) floor.

tokens.name: size-bottomnav
tokens.usage: Mobile bottom navigation including label.

tokens.name: size-sidebar
tokens.usage: Expanded web sidebar.

tokens.name: size-sidebar-rail
tokens.usage: Collapsed sidebar rail (tablet, or user-collapsed).

tokens.name: size-drawer
tokens.usage: Right drawer (admin review, transaction detail).

tokens.name: size-drawer-wide
tokens.usage: Drawer at bp-wide and diff reviews.

tokens.name: size-content
tokens.usage: Clinical page max width.

tokens.name: size-reading
tokens.usage: Clinical reading column max width.

tokens.name: size-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialog width (confirmation, reason).

tokens.name: size-palette
tokens.usage: Command palette width on desktop.
